arxiv-2011-14907.title: Spin polarization dynamics in the Gubser-expanding background
arxiv-2011-14907.creator: Rajeev Singh, Gabriel Sophys, Radoslaw Ryblewski
arxiv-2011-14907.description: Abstract Evolution of spin polarization in the Gubser-expanding conformal perfect-fluid hydrodynamic background is studied. The analysis of the conformal transformation properties of the conservation laws is extended to the case of the angular momentum conservation. The explicit forms of equations of motion for spin components are derived and analysed, and some special solutions are found.

arxiv-2110-05167.title: Robust and Scalable SDE Learning: A Functional Perspective
arxiv-2110-05167.creator: Scott Cameron, Tyron Cameron, Arnu Pretorius, Stephen Roberts
arxiv-2110-05167.description: Abstract Stochastic differential equations provide a rich class of flexible generative models, capable of describing a wide range of spatio-temporal processes. A host of recent work looks to learn data-representing SDEs, using neural networks and other flexible function approximators. Despite these advances, learning remains computationally expensive due to the sequential nature of SDE integrators.

arxiv-2202-08931.title: Desingularization and p-Curvature of Recurrence Operators DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: International Symposium on Symbolic and Algebraic Computation; July 04–07, 2022; Lille, France Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Computing methodologies Algebraic algorithms
arxiv-2202-08931.creator: Yi Zhou, Mark van Hoeij
arxiv-2202-08931.description: Abstract . Linear recurrence operators in characteristic p p are classified by their p p -curvature. For a recurrence operator L L , denote by χ ⁡ ( L ) \chi(L) the characteristic polynomial of its p p -curvature. We can obtain information about the factorization of L L by factoring χ ⁡ ( L ) \chi(L) .

arxiv-2203-14368.title: Random coordinate descent methods for nonseparable composite optimization
arxiv-2203-14368.creator: Flavia Chorobura, Ion Necoara
arxiv-2203-14368.description: Abstract In this paper we consider large-scale composite optimization problems having the objective function formed as a sum of two terms (possibly nonconvex), one has (block) coordinate-wise Lipschitz continuous gradient and the other is differentiable but nonseparable. Under these general settings we derive and analyze two new coordinate descent methods.

arxiv-2312-07712.title: The DEAP-3600 liquid argon optical model and NEST updates
arxiv-2312-07712.creator: S. Westerdale (on behalf of the DEAP-3600 and NEST collaborations)
arxiv-2312-07712.description: Abstract As liquid argon (LAr) detectors are made at progressively larger sizes, accurate models of LAr optical properties become increasingly important for simulating light transport, understanding signals, and developing analyses. The refractive index, group velocity, and Rayleigh scattering length are particularly important for vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) and visible photons in detectors with diameters much greater than one meter.

arxiv-2403-18652.title: The Tolman-Ehrenfest effect for an ideal gas in a background of time-independent electric, magnetic, and gravitational fields
arxiv-2403-18652.creator: H. Arthur Weldon
arxiv-2403-18652.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by H. Arthur Weldon. The statistical mechanics of an ideal gas of point particles moving in a time independent background metric with g 0 ​ j ≠ 0 g_{0j}\neq 0 is investigated. An explicit calculation shows that when there is no background electrostatic or magnetostatic field the thermodynamic pressure, energy density, and thermally averaged energy-momentum tensor depend on temperature and chemical potential only through the ratios T 0 / g 00 T_{0}/\sqrt{g_{00}} and μ 0 / g 00 \mu_{0}/\sqrt{g_{00}} .

arxiv-2512-14008.title: Sparse-LaViDa: Sparse Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
arxiv-2512-14008.creator: Shufan Li, Jiuxiang Gu, Kangning Liu, Zhe Lin, Zijun Wei, Aditya Grover, Jason Kuen
arxiv-2512-14008.description: Abstract Masked Discrete Diffusion Models (MDMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, including image understanding, generation, and editing. However, their inference speed remains suboptimal due to the need to repeatedly process redundant masked tokens at every sampling step.

pmc-10672073.description: Tricalcium silicate (C3S) as a binder material has a decisive influence on the processes of hardening and strength gain of cements and concretes. pmc-11674489.title: Discovering prominent differences in structural and functional connectomes using a multinomial stochastic block model
pmc-11674489.creator: Nina Braad Iskov, Anders Stevnhoved Olsen, Kristoffer Hougaard Madsen, Morten Mørup
pmc-11674489.description: Understanding the differences between functional and structural human brain connectivity has been a focus of an extensive amount of neuroscience research. We employ a novel approach using the multinomial stochastic block model (MSBM) to explicitly extract components that characterize prominent differences across graphs.

pmc-12304907.title: Food selectivity and autism: A systematic review
pmc-12304907.creator: Rosaria Ferrara, Leonardo Iovino, Lidia Ricci, Angiola Avallone, Roberto Latina, Pasquale Ricci
pmc-12304907.description: BACKGROUNDAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder that manifests in the first years of life, with a complex pathogenesis influenced by biological, genetic and epigenetic factors. Many children with ASD display marked food selectivity, often restricting themselves to a narrow range of foods.

pmc-12807961.title: Complement-mediated and direct activation of human neutrophils induced by Premolis semirufa caterpillar toxins
pmc-12807961.creator: Joel J. M. Gabrili, Ângela A. A. Megale, Giselle Pidde, Trent M. Woodruff, Denise V. Tambourgi
pmc-12807961.description: IntroductionPararamosis is an occupational inflammatory disease caused by contact with hairs of the caterpillar Premolis semirufa, endemic to the Brazilian Amazon and primarily affecting rubber tree workers. Exposure to pararama hairs induces acute pruritic dermatitis and, in some cases, chronic joint inflammation resembling rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis.

pmc-13236166.title: Neonatal torsion of the vermiform appendix presenting as generalized peritonitis: a case report of a 10-day-old infant
pmc-13236166.creator: Lai Van Chu, Quynh Thi Vu Huynh, Trang Lu Quy, Ho Tran Ban
pmc-13236166.description: Introduction:Torsion of the vermiform appendix is an extremely rare surgical emergency in children and has not previously been reported during the neonatal period. Because clinical manifestations are nonspecific, the diagnosis is usually established intraoperatively. We report a case of appendiceal torsion occurring in a 10-day-old male neonate who was diagnosed and treated at our institution.
